label: Rotating triangle, rooted pair and uncovered edge controls, checked
description: Controls for J2 and its rival. The rotating triangle shows that well-founded support at every world together with the negation of the mutual-support rival yields neither J2 nor the join's endpoint: a three-step cross-world cycle survives. The rooted pair shows that the mutual-support rival is compatible with the join's endpoint, every other premise of NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks and coverage, so J2, the no-novel-edge condition and same-supporter presence are each stronger than the endpoint needs. The uncovered edge shows that J1 and J2 with the other premises imply neither coverage nor the no-novel-edge condition. Model-witnessed only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible. Excluded middle is supplied by Lean's classical axioms.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.rootedPair at world false: the rival, EveryWorldGroundingWF, concrete population, ActualGroundingWF, EveryContingentGroundedAt, ActualReflexive, NoContingentConcreteSupport, coverage and excluded middle hold; ConcreteNecessaryUnionWF, NoNovelNecessarySupport and NecessarySupportIsPresent fail; NecessaryConcreteUnderivedAt holds.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Profile, selected relation and selected world as the premise; two mutually accessible worlds, three candidates, all concrete and necessary.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation; it shows compatibility of the rival with the join's endpoint, not survival against it.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival implies the negation of J2 (existing mutualSupport_excludes); it does not imply the negation of the endpoint.
research_comparisons.witness: Control.rootedPair in Control.RootedPairCompatible; controls proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: The rival defeats the endpoint only when the actual necessary root is itself supported elsewhere, which violates coverage (underivedOfCoverage). Assess the warrant of coverage against accounts that let a necessary concretum lack every actual concrete supporter while having one elsewhere; contingency of individual grounding edges alone does not deny coverage.
